import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth"],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
)
django.setup()

from django.db import models

# Order A: parent_link field FIRST (this is the case that must work)
class DocumentA(models.Model):
    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"

class PickingA(DocumentA):
    document_ptr = models.OneToOneField(DocumentA, on_delete=models.CASCADE, parent_link=True, related_name='+')
    origin = models.OneToOneField(DocumentA, related_name='picking_a', on_delete=models.PROTECT)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"

# Order B: parent_link field SECOND (bug report says this fails)
class DocumentB(models.Model):
    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"

class PickingB(DocumentB):
    origin = models.OneToOneField(DocumentB, related_name='picking_b', on_delete=models.PROTECT)
    document_ptr = models.OneToOneField(DocumentB, on_delete=models.CASCADE, parent_link=True, related_name='+')

    class Meta:
        app_label = "repro"

print("ORDER A (parent_link first): pk =", PickingA._meta.pk.name)
print("ORDER B (parent_link last):  pk =", PickingB._meta.pk.name)
assert PickingA._meta.pk.name == "document_ptr"
assert PickingB._meta.pk.name == "document_ptr", "BUG: pk is %r" % PickingB._meta.pk.name
print("OK: both orders give document_ptr as pk")
